Tata Motors shares slide in fictional scenario

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: invented automotive story used to test group-company disambiguation.

In this imaginary scenario, shares of Tata Motors fell 4% after a cyberattack disrupted production at Jaguar Land Rover plants in the United Kingdom.

Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran said in the fictional statement that the group would support the carmaker and that dealers would receive updates.

Tata Steel and other group companies were not affected, the invented report added, and the outage was expected to last two weeks.

Analysts in the scenario cut their forecast for vehicle deliveries in the quarter and warned of a margin decline at the luxury unit.
